ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $BD = \frac{1}{5}BC$, $AE = \frac{1}{4}AD$, and $CF = \frac{1}{2}CE$. Given that the area of $\triangle ABC = 30$, what is the area of $\triangle DEF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:}\\
$\because BD= \frac{1}{5} BC$,\\
$\therefore CD= \frac{4}{5} BC$,\\
$\therefore S_{\triangle ACD}= \frac{4}{5} S_{\triangle ABC}= \frac{4}{5} \times 30 = 24$,\\
$\because AE= \frac{1}{4} AD$,\\
$\therefore DE= \frac{3}{4} AD$,\\
$\therefore S_{\triangle CDE}= \frac{3}{4} S_{\triangle ACD}= \frac{3}{4} \times 24 = 18$,\\
$\because CF= \frac{1}{2} CE$,\\
$\therefore EF= \frac{1}{2} CE$,\\
$\therefore S_{\triangle DEF}= \frac{1}{2} S_{\triangle CDE}= \frac{1}{2} \times 18 = \boxed{9}$.
